blocs.regle: Comme dans une question, mais la phrase **insiste**. Sans auxiliaire, on appelle **do / does / did**.

lignes: **Never have I** seen such a crowd. · **Seldom do we** see such courage.
**Not only did he** lie, **but** he **also** stole.
**Hardly had she** arrived **when** the phone rang.
**Only then did I** understand. · **Little did they** know…

oui.texte: **Hardly** had she left **when** it rained. · **No sooner** had he left **than** it rained.

non.texte: No sooner had he left **when**… — No sooner va avec **than**.

etapes.texte: Négatif ou restrictif, **en tête** de phrase.
Verbe lexical à la **base verbale**, sans -s ni -ed.

blocs.texte: Not only did the government ignore the warnings, but it also cut the budget. (Non seulement le gouvernement a ignoré les avertissements, mais il a aussi réduit le budget.)

items.texte: = If I had known, I would have come.
= If she were here, she would help.
En ouverture ou en conclusion de paragraphe.

items: Pas d’inversion sans adverbe en tête : I never have seen est neutre.
Not only did he **lied** → Not only did he **lie**.
Only then did I understand : l’inversion suit only then, pas le contraire.

questions: No sooner had he left ___ it rained.
Had I known équivaut à quelle structure ?
blocs.reponses: 1) Rarely does she complain 2) than 3) If I had known
